$comment: Canonical version is 1.0.0 (interop/SCHEMA_VERSION). schema_version is a pattern, not a const, so the schema itself accepts any same-major 1.x.y version per interop/CONTRACT_VERSIONING.md (ISSUE-09/10 fix, 2026-11-11); the previous const "1.0.0" contradicted the same-major acceptance in the code. ISSUE-52/53 (2026-11-11): reason_code gains UNSUPPORTED_MAJOR_VERSION (already emitted by Rust and Julia for a major mismatch) and UNSUPPORTED_OPERATOR (Rust and Julia; Python raises ValueError for a bad operator at its boundary instead). ISSUE-53 definition of normalized_*: normalized_value is the request value converted into bound_unit (the constraint's unit), e.g. 0.008 m3 against a 10 L bound normalises to 8.0, NOT an echo of the input value; normalized_unit is the unit normalized_value is expressed in — always bound_unit when normalized_value is present, null otherwise; both are null when evaluation never reached a comparison.
